# `empty`

Helper: `empty(title, hint, { icon, actions, flat })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): `EmptyState` (`empty-state.tsx`) · status: src/ui  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaEmpty` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Optional icon tile (brand-50), title (body-lg 600), hint (body, ink-soft, max 420), optional actions.

## Variants

- Default card
- `flat`: no card chrome, centred grey text inside a card

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

surface, line, shadow-card, brand-50, brand-500, ink, ink-soft

## Do

- Say what is missing and the one action that fixes it

## Don't

- Do not apologise or explain at length
- Do not offer two equal primary actions

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Padding 40/24.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.
